fields.admin_requirements: Imager management command exposes durable burn queue, status, and worker operations.
fields.public_requirements: No public interface; destructive burns remain limited to authenticated operators and service workers.
fields.service_requirements: Requires a Control node, Linux block-device discovery tools, a configured systemd worker for long-running writes, and local USB quieting around destructive burn windows.
fields.summary: Controls durable SD-card burn queueing and worker execution for Control nodes.
